verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec exists, and Grafana documents observability-as-code for defining dashboards, data sources and other configurations in code, plus a terminal CLI for administrative tasks and an official MCP server for agents. However, no evidence states that the API covers everything the UI can do, and alerting, SLO and incident features are described only as UI workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, evidence that alerting, SLO and on-call/incident management are fully API-driven, and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
